$comment: Klemme15 service functions: things that change something in the car (registrations, calibrations, adaptation resets, component tests). Written by contributors in their own words. 'implementations' say how to run a function on each module variant: 'job' + 'args' run BMW's own job from the user's files (EDIABAS mode); 'native' is a request Klemme15 sends itself (hex), allowed only when the request is documented for exactly those variants, with 'expect' the start of the positive reply. 'resultJob'/'resultArgs' read the outcome afterwards. 'checks': requirements Klemme15 verifies before running (ignition, engine off/running, minimum battery voltage, car stationary) plus 'confirm' items the user must tick. 'verified' stays false until the function has been confirmed on a real car; unverified functions only run with 'experimental service functions' switched on. Never add flashing, coding or immobiliser functions here.

functions.title: Register a new battery
functions.summary: Tells the engine computer a new battery was fitted, so it stops charging as if the old, worn battery were still there.
functions.when: After fitting a new battery of the same type and capacity as the old one.
before: The new battery must match the old one's type (AGM or standard) and capacity. A different type or capacity also needs the car's coding changed, which Klemme15 doesn't do.
after: Nothing else to do: charging adapts over the next drives.
Clear the fault memories if fitting the battery left low-voltage faults behind.

confirm: The new battery is the same type and capacity as the old one.

functions.title: Calibrate the steering angle sensor
functions.summary: Teaches the stability control module where 'straight ahead' is.
functions.when: After a wheel alignment, steering repairs, or when the steering angle reads off-centre with the wheels straight.
before: Park on level ground with the wheels pointing exactly straight ahead and the steering wheel centred. Don't touch the wheel during the calibration.
after: Check on the Readings page that the steering angle now reads close to zero with the wheels straight.
Clear the DSC fault memory, then test drive carefully: the DSC light should stay off and the car should not brake on its own.

confirm: The wheels point straight ahead and the steering wheel is centred.
The car is on level ground and nobody will touch the steering wheel.

functions.title: Reset automatic gearbox adaptations
functions.summary: Clears what the automatic gearbox has learned about shift timing and pressure, so it relearns from scratch.
functions.when: After a gearbox fluid change or a repair, or when shifts have become harsh or slurred.
after: Shifts may feel firm or soft for a while. Drive gently through all gears, including several light-throttle up- and downshifts, so it relearns.

functions.title: Initialise the windows (one-touch and anti-trap)
functions.summary: Teaches the footwell module the windows' end positions, so one-touch up/down and the anti-trap protection work again.
functions.when: After the battery was disconnected or flat, or when one-touch window operation stopped working.
before: Close all doors. The windows will move on their own: keep hands, pets and objects out of the way.
after: Try one-touch up and down on each window.

confirm: All doors are closed and nothing is in the way of the windows.

functions.title: Test the radiator fan
functions.summary: Runs the electric radiator fan at half speed for 10 seconds.
functions.when: When you suspect the fan or its wiring (overheating at idle, fan faults).
before: Keep hands, tools and clothing away from the fan.
after: If the fan didn't run, check its fuse, connector and wiring before replacing it.

functions.title: Test the fuel pump
functions.summary: Switches the in-tank fuel pump on for 10 seconds. Listen under the rear seat.
functions.when: Long cranking, no start, or low fuel pressure faults.
before: Engine off. No work on the fuel system while testing.
after: No sound often means the pump, its fuse/relay, or (on some cars) the fuel pump control module.

confirm: Nobody is working on the fuel lines.

functions.title: Test the map thermostat heater
functions.summary: Powers the electric heater in the map-controlled thermostat for 30 seconds.
functions.when: Thermostat faults, or a coolant temperature that never settles where it should.
after: If the module reports the thermostat circuit faulty, check the connector before replacing the thermostat.

functions.title: Test the electric water pump
functions.summary: Runs the electric coolant pump at half speed for 20 seconds. You may hear it and feel the coolant hoses pulse.
functions.when: Water pump faults or overheating warnings.
before: The cooling system must be full: never run the pump dry.
after: If it doesn't run, check its connector and power supply first.

functions.title: Test the secondary air pump
functions.summary: Runs the secondary air pump for 10 seconds. It is loud by design.
after: If it runs but the fault remains, check the hoses and the check valve.

functions.title: Test the throttle valve
functions.summary: Opens the electronic throttle to half for 5 seconds, so you can watch or hear it move.
functions.when: Throttle faults, or after cleaning the throttle body.
before: Engine off. Keep fingers out of the throttle body.

confirm: Nothing is inside the throttle body.

functions.title: Test the intake (DISA) flap
functions.summary: Switches the variable intake flap for 5 seconds. Listen for a click at the intake manifold.
functions.when: DISA faults, a flat spot in the mid-range.
